mapper.select: SELECT u.id FROM sys_user u JOIN vehicle v ON v.id = u.vehicle_id AND v.fleet_id = u.fleet_id WHERE u.id = #{driverId} AND v.id = #{vehicleId} AND u.role = 'DRIVER' AND u.enabled = 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vehicle_telemetry (vehicle_id, driver_id, sampled_at, latitude, longitude, speed_kmh) VALUES (#{vehicleId}, #{driverId}, #{sampledAt}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{speedKmh,jdbcType=DOUBLE}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE sampled_at = vehicle_telemetry.sampled_at
